integrity: The all-parameter homotopy statement is proved symbolically from exact graph distances, an exhaustive scale-two clique classification, a contractible-core reduction, and triangle attachments. Computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the vertex set of the once-subdivided complete graph with shortest-path metric, not the continuous metric realization or iterated subdivisions.
The finite verifier covers n from 3 through 7 and supports the exact combinatorial model; the general result rests on the symbolic proof.
Focused searches cannot exclude an older equivalent statement under graph-power or flag-complex terminology.
title: The Rips filtration of the complete-graph subdivision has two consecutive sphere wedges
